author: Animalogic
description:
The great monarch migration is one of the most impressive events in nature. A tiny butterfly flies thousands of miles from Canada and the Northern US to Mexico to spend overwinter. But recently, fewer and fewer monarchs are completing the trip. In this episode we investigate the the causes of these incomplete migrations to try to figure out how to help monarchs.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
